title: Raise execute_tactus runtime budget defaults
description: Increase the local MCP execute_tactus parent budget defaults and make them configurable via environment variables so async child operations can request practical budgets without pre-dispatch failures.

comments.author: ryan
comments.text: Implemented env-overridable execute_tactus parent budget defaults and raised local defaults to allow practical async child-operation dispatches. Focused MCP runtime budget tests pass locally.

comments.author: unknown
comments.text: Closed in board cleanup 2026-10-17: the project is on hold and Ryan called the remaining gaps YAGNI; reopen if they become an issue.
